Strong daily/weekly uptrend with consecutive positive days; the speaker permits current longs to keep holding but sees no clear new entry.

decision: Source-inconclusive for a separate post-entry early exit. It supports distinguishing an entry-time protective stop from later weak price action and may motivate a separately registered two-entry stop-geometry source case, but the ambiguous deep Fibonacci ratio, venue, causal anchors and conflict with H15a's three-tier common below-origin stop forbid direct parameter substitution or an annual replay from S44 alone.
limitations: Fast ASR and selected original frames were inspected, without independent audio review.
The visible TradingView BTCUSDT chart does not prove Binance perpetual execution venue.
The source date is inside the exposed annual backtest period and is not an independent economic holdout.
